newsitem.title: SPAIN: Wall St gives Madrid stocks a boost before Aug CPI.
newsitem.headline: Wall St gives Madrid stocks a boost before Aug CPI.

text.p: Madrid stocks closed higher on Thursday, boosted by gains on Wall Street.
Short term, trade may be volatile with U.S. and domestic CPI due tomorrow, as well as a Bank of Spain repo auction.
The general index rose 2.21 points, 0.63 percent, to 354.16 and the Ibex rose 29.10 points, 0.73 percent, to 4,030.44.
Repsol added 35 pesetas to 4,195 amid oil sector gains. Bearish feeling on the firm seems to have diminished and its position is strong vis a vis a domestic price war, dealers said.
"A good performance abroad has let us gain ground, with a more lively tone than usual although volume again has been a bit low," said one dealer.
Traders were not ruling out more gains tomorrow if Spain's August CPI is under the 3.9 percent most expect.
The central bank meanwhile is expected to leave its key rate steady at 7.25 percent.
Nevertheless any advance may be capped by the prospect of U.S inflation data, and the tone may be nervous, they added.
